newsitem.title: BULGARIA: IMF DISBURSES $178.7 MLN BULGARIA TRANCHE - BNB.
newsitem.headline: IMF DISBURSES $178.7 MLN BULGARIA TRANCHE - BNB.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has disbursed $178.7 million of a $657 million funding package approved last week, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Thursday.

"Of the $178.747 million received in BNB accounts...$31.704 million are the first tranche of the 14-month standby...and $147.043 million are the Compensatory and Contingency Financing Facility (CCFF)," said the BNB in a statement.

The IMF approved last week a $510 million 14-month standby credit to enable Bulgaria to carry out reforms including introduction of a currency board, a self-regulating monetary mechanism designed to curb inflation and stabilise the lev currency.
The currency board is expected to be introduced in June by the new government and parliament to be formed after Saturday's elections.

The CCFF loan was extended to fund grain imports to offset acute wheat shortages caused by uncontrolled exports two years ago and a bad harvest last year. -- Elisaveta Konstantinova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
